result.conclusion: The tracking endpoint (http://localhost:3000/#/track-result) is vulnerable to XSS. The payload `<script>alert('xss')</script>` was reflected in the HTML response, allowing the alert to be executed. This vulnerability can be exploited to steal session cookies or perform other malicious actions.

findings.details: The tracking endpoint reflects user input without sanitization, allowing XSS payloads to be executed in the browser. The payload `<script>alert('xss')</script>` was reflected in the HTML response.
findings.impact: High - Can steal session cookies, redirect users to malicious sites, or perform other malicious actions.
